stories.title: Sources: Cardinals finalizing deal to trade WR Harrison Jr.
stories.summary: The Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade Marvin Harrison Jr., sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Marsh's 4th-down TD lifts Indiana to comeback win over Nebraska
stories.summary: Nick Marsh scored a 44-yard touchdown on fourth down to give No. 7 Indiana its first lead in a 20-17 victory over Nebraska on Saturday.

stories.title: UNC knocks off Pitt as Belichick gets first win vs. ranked foe
stories.summary: Billy Edwards Jr. threw a 75-yard TD pass in the second half and North Carolina knocked off No. 25 Pittsburgh for coach Bill Belichick's first win vs. a ranked team.

stories.title: USWNT gets lesson from Spain in loss to world champions
stories.summary: Patri Guijarro and Eva Navarro scored in the first 14 minutes, and Adriana Nanclares stopped a second-half penalty kick to lift Spain to a 2-0 victory over the United States on Saturday.

stories.title: Banks, No. 4 in SC Next class of 2027, commits to South Carolina
stories.summary: Jezelle "GG" Banks, the No. 4-ranked player and one of the top point guards in the SC Next class of 2027, has committed to South Carolina.
